description.value:
Trigger You Draw a Card.

As you tap upon the designated future, you shift your presence ever so slightly to a more advantageous position. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{Step} to an adjacent square of your choice. If you choose to Step into difficult terrain, you can do so if you successfully make a @Check[history-lore|dc:@self.level] (or similar Lore) check against a Normal DC or an @Check[arcana|dc:@self.level|adjustment:2] check against a Hard DC for your level. On a Failure, but not a Critical Failure, you can pick a different, non-difficult terrain square to move to, otherwise you remain in your space.
